systems.country_label: Western Africa Regional Digital Integration Program (DTfA/WARDIP SOP1, P176932)
systems.owner: World Bank; Mauritania component under the digital transformation ministry
systems.tiers: national; regional programme of US$293.00m with Mauritania at US$60.00m IDA plus US$1.00m government counterpart per the capture note

systems.system: national whole-government digitalization strategy (planned under WARDIP subcomponent 4.3)
systems.owner: entities in charge of whole-government digitalization strategies
